name: job-manager
description: Job manager MVP — profiles, running jobs, interviews

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.serve: npm run build:client && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run preview"
